items.title: Jessie Charles Interview, 1967-12-15
items.q: I mean, like Buddy Petit. Well, they was playing different places.

ctx.x: Different places like that. Did you ever play around customizing the basin? No, no, no. Where all the fast women were in? No, no, no.

I remember those days. I remember those days. I remember those days. But that was before my time. Yeah, before my time. Yeah, I remember Basin Street. All down in the district. But that was before my time. I had to start playing there. Did they have many bands in the district when you were here? Yeah, they had quite a few bands. I mean, like Buddy Petit. Well, they was playing different places. They had bamboo band at the time.
Did they play in the Red Light District though? Did you ever see them down there?
